in_marathi.name: Kanakavalli
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanakavalli हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kanakavalli is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'Golden Goddess'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Lakshmi, the embodiment of wealth and prosperity, is often depicted as adorned with gold and covered in gold coins. This name is a reminder of her abundance and generosity.
